provenance.construction: one-block cyclic stabilizer code: generator X^a Z^b with a(x) = x + x^16, b(x) = x^3 + x^5 + x^6 + x^11 + x^12 + x^14 in F_2[x]/(x^17 - 1) and its 17 cyclic shifts; palindromic a and b make the shifts commute. The witness X I I I I X I I I I I I Y Y Z I I ... has Pauli weight 7 (two Y factors)
provenance.notes: The checks are byte-for-byte those of the board entry codes/17-1-7.json (the one-block palindromic cyclic code); a correction to that entry should be mirrored here. Non-CSS under every single-qubit Clifford (generators i and i+2 share an X qubit and generators i and i-2 meet X against Z, so no two-coloring of the generators exists), which is what makes it a stabilizer fixture that verifies: the XZZX toric code is the toric code behind Hadamards and is rejected. Distance 7 is exact by Pauli enumeration; recorded as upper_bound because the Pauli-weight certifier is not available.
